CustomField.description: Only relevant on Default Interest IRT rows (Rate_Segment_Type = Default_Interest). When true, accrued unpaid interest is added to the principal basis each day — interest-on-interest per Rule R20. Compounding_Frequency controls the compounding cadence. Spec v7 Part 2.11.2, Rule R20.
CustomField.label: Default Interest Compounding (IoI)
